decision.observation: At 3:20 p.m., the farmer is at a paved junction west of Pelican Town; a clear cobblestone route branches southeast on the right, while the main road continues east.
decision.hypothesis: Taking the southeast branch should lead into the southern part of town and toward the beach, avoiding the eastern riverbank dead end.
decision.memory: Willy promised an item at the southeast beach; Fish Shop hours are 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. The farm route east reaches this junction. Late nights have reduced money.
